description: This file defines classes and functions for the transformation and handling of rerank API requests and responses specific to Hosted VLLM. It includes configuration, request/response transformation, error handling, and response parsing logic tailored for reranking models in a hosted environment.

classes.name: HostedVLLMRerankConfig
